current_evidence: The council's 'What to include in your application' page links this PDF as the full validation document, alongside Table Two (local requirements) and the Table Three matrix. The PDF is dated 'July 2024' and no newer version turned up on the council site or in search.

issues.detail: The List date 2024-06-01 comes from PDF CreationDate metadata. The document text is dated July 2024, so the date should be 2024-07. The 'Outdated (>2y)' flag is still correct, since July 2024 is more than two years ago, and the list still refers to the July 2021 NPPF.
issues.evidence: Document date line: 'July 2024'; s1.1 'produced in line with the paragraphs 55-58 of the current NPPF (July 2021)'

issues.detail: These Table Two local requirements have no app-type rows: 2.4 Biodiversity Net Gain Information (all applications, with exceptions); 2.5 Building for a Healthy Life Assessment (all major developments), which appears only as a stray 'Submission rules' tab item; 2.6 Coal Risk Assessment (sites in a Coal Mining referral area); 2.13 Heritage Statement / Archaeology Assessment (proposals affecting designated heritage assets, their settings, conservation areas, locally listed buildings or SAMs, plus archaeology for major development or sites on or next to archaeological assets); 2.17 Minerals Statement (major applications in Mineral Safeguarding and Consultation Areas); 2.18 Noise Impact Assessment (significant noise or vibration, or noise-sensitive uses near noise sources); 2.19 Planning Statement incl. Statement of Community Involvement (all major development, leisure/visitor facilities, loss of community facilities); 2.20 Renewable Energy Statement (major applications and all renewable energy applications); 2.21 Secured by Design Assessment (all major applications); 2.23 Site Waste Management (residential or commercial development, including changes of use); 2.29 Photos (where plans are not practical). The EV charging point element of 2.28 is also missing; only cycle parking was captured.

Many trigger excerpts are fragments or content guidance, not the threshold. Flood Risk Assessment ('where one is Local Plan required under the NPPF') omits the actual triggers: all major development, specified Flood Zone 1 sites, and all new built development in Flood Zones 2/3. Drainage Strategy ('systems including Sustainable Drainage (SuDS). water, drains);') is garbled. Contaminated Land ('with possible land contamination should include...') omits former petrol stations, landfill and industrial sites, and vulnerable end uses such as housing. Health Impact Assessment quotes a mitigation sentence, not the 50+ dwellings / 5,000 sqm non-residential threshold. Design Code/Masterplan merges 2.7 and 2.16 and begins 'Plan more)'; the masterplan trigger is 5ha+ or 150+ dwellings and the design code trigger is large-scale major. Structural Survey ('may also be required in support of any demolition works') misstates 2.24: demolition or conversion of a listed building, and conversion of agricultural buildings. Cycle parking ('spaces and cycle storage areas in new developments') omits 'new dwellings and/or new or changes to employment premises'. Retail omits the 500 sqm edge- or out-of-centre threshold. Heads of Terms omits 'sites above 0.5ha'. Viability has no trigger (schemes not meeting policy requirements such as affordable housing). Air Quality runs on into 2.3 text. Transport and Travel Plan excerpts are cut off.
issues.evidence: Table Two 'When is this required?' column, e.g. 2.28: 'Proposals for new dwellings and/or new or changes to employment premises.'

issues.detail: The row 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is mislabelled. Its excerpt ('a polar luminance diagram ... nearest sensitive premises') comes from 2.9 External Lighting Scheme, not from any advertisement requirement. The real 2.9 lighting row uses a bat-corridor sentence as its trigger instead of 'floodlighting or external lighting ... adjacent to a residential property, outside the urban boundary, in/adjacent to a Conservation Area, on/adjacent to a Listed Building, town centres'.

All roughly 20 local rows are flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', while Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building consent and Advertisement consent are all '(none)'. But the council publishes a Table Three matrix with columns for Householder, Listed Building Consent, Conservation Area Consent, Advertisement Consent, TPO works, LDCs, Full Minor/Major, Outline Minor/Major, Reserved Matters and Telecoms. Section 4.1 says householder requirements are minimal except for listed buildings, conservation areas, TPO trees and Flood Zones. The many 'All Major Developments' items apply equally to outline major applications, and Structural Survey and Heritage Statement apply to listed building consent.
issues.evidence: Table Three Validation-Checklist.pdf matrix headers; guide s4.1 householder 'usually minimal' except listed building/conservation area/TPO/Flood Zone

issues.detail: Several rows and tab items are not local requirements. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is a sentence from the Design Code item. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is a fragment of the national site/block plan content. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is part of the FRA item. Fire Statement and EIA are national items. The 'Submission rules' tab items are boilerplate ('Should you wish to submit hard copies...', 'We are more than happy to help...' running into the Table One header). The drawing-standards item includes the stray fragment 'Fire safety and high-rise residential buildings (from 1 August 2021) - GOV.UK ( 1.8 9'.
issues.evidence: Table One items 1.7-1.10 (national); Table Two 2.7 Design Code text

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' in the reference row is the Table One national checklist page, not the page that hosts the local list. The local requirements are linked from 'What to include in your application' (Table Two PDF and the full validation PDF).
issues.evidence: https://www.tamworth.gov.uk/apply-permission/what-include-your-application links Table One, Table Two, Table Three and the full PDF

summary: Grokbot's link is the current (July 2024) Tamworth checklist, but it dated it from PDF metadata. About 11 of the 29 Table Two local requirements are missing, many triggers are garbled fragments, and every item is crammed under Full planning even though the council publishes a per-application-type matrix (Table Three).
